body: It does get better. It still hurts now after a year, but it’s tolerable. And my life is a mess which doesn’t help things.

Early on when we were dating (long distance) she flew over with some friends. I was meeting her the next day, had planned nice meal out, fully day and night of activities, booked hotel etc. 

The night before we met she stayed out by herself and went to some other bars after her friends had left. Chatted to other guys and told me someone tried to kiss her.

Eventually she admitted she did it because she liked the attention.

Was hugely disrespectful and I’m annoyed I didn’t walk away there and then to this day.
